summary: One Secure Agility camera (286) at Lawrence Hargrave Dr / Rawson St, Coledale, split into 11 zones with 22 directions; most crossing and footpath zones carry only 1-2 bikes a day and the busiest (786) ~35. Until mid-2025 the camera published zero-bike direction-days as whole-day warnings, which should be restored to 0; genuine outages are 2023-09-28..10-09, 2023-11-21..28 and 2024-06-08..11 plus partial edge days. The Sydney to the Gong rides (2024-11-03, 2025-11-02) are real; two phantom bursts on 786 in June 2024 should go; the road-lane zones 759/939/710/743 step up from 2024-11-08, apparently a detection change.
